title: XTRUST: On the Multilingual Trustworthiness of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing model safety, performance, and trustworthiness metrics across 10 different languages to identify cross-lingual disparities, particularly exposing vulnerabilities in low-resource or non-English languages.

Measuring the model's disagreement rate when explicitly prompted to agree or disagree with biased stereotype statements targeting racial groups, evaluated across benign, targeted, and untargeted zero-shot prompting scenarios using the DecodingTrust dataset.

Measuring the model's disagreement rate when explicitly prompted to agree or disagree with biased stereotype statements targeting gender groups, evaluated across benign, targeted, and untargeted zero-shot prompting scenarios using the DecodingTrust dataset.

Measuring the model's disagreement rate when explicitly prompted to agree or disagree with biased stereotype statements targeting religious groups, evaluated across benign, targeted, and untargeted zero-shot prompting scenarios using the DecodingTrust dataset.

Measuring the model's disagreement rate when explicitly prompted to agree or disagree with biased stereotype statements targeting sexual orientations (e.g., homosexuals), evaluated across benign, targeted, and untargeted zero-shot prompting scenarios using the DecodingTrust dataset.
